MHCC Women on Wheels (WOW) Rides

Albany, NY · Road · Social

MHCC Women on Wheels (WOW) Rides is a road and social group ride in Albany, NY. It rolls some Saturdays and Sundays at 9:30 am from Different each ride; Oct 10 starts at Murray Park, Hudson Falls.

For visitors

Women only. Bring a friend or a sister if you like; tell the leader ahead so she can take emergency contact details and register her. New riders must tick the waiver box online or no registration goes through. Time is on each ride listing.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the MHCC Women on Wheels (WOW) Rides group ride

Women-only rides from the Mohawk Hudson Cycling Club, on paved rail trails and quiet roads with a coffee or bagel stop. The host says the rides are meant to be safe, non-competitive and judgement free, to build the women's community in the club.
